title: Ezekiel's Symbolic Act with the Hair and Judgment on Jerusalem
description: God commands the prophet Ezekiel to shave his head and beard with a sharp sword, dividing the hair into three parts as a symbolic act representing Jerusalem's coming judgment: one third will be burned in the city, one third struck down by the sword around it, and one third scattered to the wind. This warns that the inhabitants will die from plague and famine, fall by the sword, or be dispersed among the nations as punishment for defiling God's sanctuary and rejecting His laws [ref:Ezek 5:1-17|Ezekiel 5:1-17].
